messages.content: Johnny had an allowance of $20 and he supplemented it with an additional $10. This total amount was then invested and it tripled over the course of a year. What was the total amount of money he had after a year?

content.text:
Johnny had an allowance of $20 and he supplemented it with an additional $10, so his total amount was:

$20 + $10 = $30

This total amount was then invested and it tripled over the course of a year. So, the total amount after a year would be:

$30 × 3 = $90

Therefore, the total amount of money Johnny had after a year is **$90**.
